Agent Name: Verification_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly treated the average observed p-value (0.04) as the false-positive/Type I error rate to be multiplied by the total number of papers. The Type I error rate is determined by the pre-set alpha (typically 0.05), and a p-value is not the probability a result is false. This flawed premise led downstream agents to compute 0.04 × N and produce the wrong final answer (further compounded by using an unverified estimate of N).
